name: HARUM Immune Mesh
purpose: Cryptographic identity, capability-scoped authority and safe self-update for the decentralized organism.
principles: Every peer has a cryptographic identity.
Events and update manifests can be signed and independently verified.
Capabilities are explicit, scoped and expiring.
Untrusted network data is data, never executable authority.
Self-improvement proposals enter quarantine before promotion.
Promotion requires signature, hash integrity, tests and rollback metadata.
research_assimilation: libp2p PeerID + secure channel identity pattern
TUF compartmentalized trust and rollback/freeze defense
